# Account Runtime

<a id="reconnect-account-runtime"></a>

## `reconnectAccountRuntime`

Reconnect account runtime

TikTok reconnect applies provider_data.enable_comment; a Boolean body override may explicitly disable it. String, numeric and null values return 400 invalid_request. Polling defaults off; disabling does not retract queued events.

| Property        | Value                                                                               |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/accounts/{account_id}/runtime/reconnect`                                |
| SDK method      | `device.reconnectAccountRuntime(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["reconnectAccountRuntime"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                                |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                             |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                                |

### Parameters

| SDK field                | Location | Required | Type     | Example     | Constraints | Description                                                   |
| ------------------------ | -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `params.path.account_id` | path     | Yes      | `string` | `"acc_xxx"` | -           | Public account ID issued by the API, for example acc_example. |

### Request body

Channel action parameters vary by operation/provider; {} supplies no extra parameters.

| Field  | Required | Type             | Constraints | Description |
| ------ | -------- | ---------------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| `body` | No       | `FreeFormObject` | -           | -           |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | The account runtime action result.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Server request processing failed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Channel unavailable or invalid response. Protocol login restriction uses 30020: stop automatic retry and check the official WhatsApp app. WhatsApp disconnection uses 30021 across messages/contacts/groups: pause dependent requests, refresh runtime, restore connection and confirm running before resuming. It does not prove logout or invalid authorization, nor automatically retry/reconnect/change state. 30010 may include an original reason; branch on codes, not text. WhatsApp group-admin send rejection uses 34012: resolve permissions before resending. |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `200` response fields:

| Field                               | Present | Type                                                                | Constraints                                                                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `result.data.request_id`            | No      | `string`                                                            | -                                                                                                     | The request ID generated by the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `result.data.client_request_id`     | No      | `string`                                                            | -                                                                                                     | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `result.data.data`                  | Yes     | `RuntimeActionResult`                                               | -                                                                                                     | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `result.data.data.account_id`       | Yes     | `string`                                                            | -                                                                                                     | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `result.data.data.provider`         | Yes     | `ProviderName`                                                      | enum="telegram", "whatsapp", "line", "twitter", "zalo", "tiktok", "whatsapp-protocol"                 | Canonical response provider name. whatsapp-protocol supports session authorization, text/image and contact detail; reply, mentions, contact-list/writes, conversations and groups are unsupported. Availability depends on the deployed service.                                                  |
| `result.data.data.action`           | Yes     | `string enum("refresh_status" \| "start" \| "stop" \| "reconnect")` | enum="refresh_status", "start", "stop", "reconnect"                                                   | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `result.data.data.operation_status` | Yes     | `string`                                                            | -                                                                                                     | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `result.data.data.runtime_status`   | Yes     | `RuntimeStatus`                                                     | enum="unknown", "starting", "running", "stopping", "stopped", "reconnecting", "disconnected", "error" | Standard runtime state: ready/online/connected/active/started normalize to running; offline/inactive/stop to stopped; failed to error. Raw states are not returned.                                                                                                                               |
| `result.data.data.runtime_error`    | Yes     | `string`                                                            | -                                                                                                     | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `result.data.data.auth_required`    | No      | `boolean`                                                           | -                                                                                                     | Optional true only with confirmed QR/Passkey or persisted authorization-progress evidence, never inferred from disconnected/client_connect=false alone. Runtime results do not contain QR/code/qrcode/auth_payload/provider_data. Use auth/qr/start and auth/qr/check for standard state/payload. |
| `result.data.data.auth_status`      | No      | `string`                                                            | -                                                                                                     | Optional confirmed authorization-state snapshot, such as pending/awaiting_qr_scan/passkey_required. Directs callers to authorization but does not replace its complete result.                                                                                                                    |

### TypeScript example

```ts
const result = await device.reconnectAccountRuntime({
  params: {
    path: {
      account_id: "acc_xxx"
    }
  }
});
console.log(result.data.data);
```

<a id="start-account-runtime"></a>

## `startAccountRuntime`

Start account runtime

TikTok accepts a Boolean enable_comment override, otherwise uses provider_data.enable_comment, default false. Repeated start does not guarantee configuration application; reconnect to apply changes. HTTP 200 means accepted or already satisfied, not connected. WhatsApp running/starting/reconnecting/stopping results must not trigger repeated starts. auth_required=true and auth_status direct the caller to authorization; disconnected alone does not prove authorization is needed. pending can mean QR generation is in progress. Existing QR/Passkey progress is preserved. Uncertain or concurrently changed state can return 409 without starting again.

| Property        | Value                                                                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/accounts/{account_id}/runtime/start`                                |
| SDK method      | `device.startAccountRuntime(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["startAccountRuntime"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                            |

| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                            |
